digest.component_or_area: bedrock LLM provider parity measurement harness
propositions: Bedrock must clear the non-inferiority bar (structured-output validity, zero decision-level flips on gold set, recall and false-accept within 2pp, error rate, and gold-coverage floor) before becoming a first-class provider in S8.

A paired corpus run with N=3 epochs per arm across 30 stratified gold-labeled cases (15 block, 15 advisory) pooled from 15 specs must measure Bedrock against direct Anthropic with provider as the only variable, using the same per-pass model class on both arms.

Step 1 probe for each inference-profile id (bare call and temperature=0) must succeed invokable in account 896586841071/us-east-1 before corpus spend; partial invokability is recorded as unmeasured for that slot rather than silently skipped.

The v2 Bedrock arm must make zero calls to a non-Bedrock provider, verified via REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call model tally, because bare ladder entries infer anthropic provider and would silently collapse the provider comparison.

Errored ItemRecords must not register as decision flips in parity_report; temperature rejections must be classified separately from other validation errors and mark the slot INVALID rather than a parity failure.
